neighbours.label: the split-off first letter (' p', ' к', ' п') of a word broken by the tokenizer, mostly for small physical masses or pieces (piers, pucks, pustules, куски), as opposed to whole-word tokens for the same kinds of objects
fire: After the game the kids left a bag of old pucks by the bench.
The pier was rebuilt on new steel piers after the hurricane.
The doctor drained a single pustule on the patient's wrist.
Small white puffs of smoke rose from the chimney in the cold air.
Unopened letters were piling up on the kitchen table.
Мама нарезала хлеб на ровные куски и положила их на тарелку.
Он отломил маленький кусочек шоколада и отдал его сестре.
Девочка собрала цветы в небольшие пучки и связала их лентой.
quiet: After the game the kids left a bag of old balls by the bench.

The doctor drained a single blister on the patient's wrist.
Small white clouds of smoke rose from the chimney in the cold air.

The workers broke the old wall into chunks and loaded the truck.
Он нашёл красивые камни на берегу и отдал их сестре.
A large pile of firewood was stacked against the barn.
